summary: Production Grafana gets a Keycloak generic-OAuth button beside the local form. The gate is on the access token's resource_access.grafana.roles admin role, which maps to Grafana Admin, and strict mode refuses everyone else; checked against Grafana 12.3.1's source and a rendered template. Client id and secret come only through the grafana-oidc ExternalSecret, and the dev release is untouched. One advisory finding.

findings.summary: root_url pins grafana.home, so a Keycloak sign-in started at the still-served http://grafana/ short name fails once with 'Missing saved oauth state' (host-only state cookie)
